facts.statement: Zefram Cochrane flies the Phoenix on 5 April 2063.
facts.howUsed: Background: why settlement accelerates.

facts.statement: Earth passes warp 2 in the 2140s, launches a warp 5 ship in 2151 and reaches warp 7 by 2161. Ships cruise at warp 6 in the 2260s and exceed warp 9 in the 24th century.
facts.howUsed: A "reach" score that rises every year from 2151.

facts.statement: Earth has subspace communication by 2151 and needs amplifiers to reach distant ships. Enterprise deploys the first, Echo One, in August 2151. Relay networks replace amplifiers by the 24th century.
facts.howUsed: Constellations are subspace from 2151; older ones convert.

facts.statement: "Approximately 52,000 times the speed of light." Data's figure in "Where No One Has Gone Before" works out to about 52,090.
episodes: TNG: Where No One Has Gone Before
facts.howUsed: Latency figures, at 52,000 times light speed.

facts.statement: New Berlin is built between 2063 and 2069. The Orpheus Mining Complex is built in 2090.
facts.howUsed: Settled before the start, dated 2069.

facts.statement: Settlements exist by 2069, tied to Utopia Planitia. Mars is colonized in 2103. Terraforming is under way by 2155.
facts.howUsed: Settled before the start, dated 2103; first relay 2069.

facts.statement: Named with New Berlin as built before 2069. Builds starships in the 24th century.
facts.howUsed: The single shipyard all expeditions leave from.

facts.statement: A station in orbit of Jupiter repairs and loads ships in 2151.
facts.howUsed: Jupiter starts with an orbital station.

facts.statement: Deuterium fuels matter-antimatter reactors, and 22nd-century colonies extract it.
facts.howUsed: Hydrogen-bearing worlds count as fuel sources.

facts.statement: By 2364 terraforming a world takes about 30 years.
facts.howUsed: Caps how fast Venus can be finished.

facts.statement: Inhabited by 2268: Scott has a drink he found there.
facts.howUsed: Not steered toward: the simulation is checked against it across 400 runs.

facts.statement: A mine is operating by 2259; a research colony exists, undated.
facts.howUsed: Not steered toward: the simulation is checked against it across 400 runs.

facts.statement: Chakotay trains in its storms in the 2340s; terraforming stations by 2371.
facts.howUsed: Not steered toward: the simulation is checked against it across 400 runs.

facts.statement: An emergency evacuation station by 2368.
facts.howUsed: Not steered toward: the simulation is checked against it across 400 runs.

facts.statement: Navigational control satellites in orbit by 2368.
facts.howUsed: Not steered toward: the simulation is checked against it across 400 runs.

facts.statement: Over 50 million people on the Moon in 2373.
facts.howUsed: Not steered toward: the simulation is checked against it across 400 runs.

facts.statement: A lunar government exists in 2039.
facts.howUsed: From the reference book Star Trek: Star Charts, not an episode.

facts.topic: Research outposts on Ganymede and Europa in the early 2100s
facts.statement: Research outposts on Ganymede and Europa in the early 2100s.
episodes: TNG: Chain of Command, Part II
facts.howUsed: Not found on screen. Europa has no settlement recorded before an emergency centre in 3190. The Jovian Run is a 24th-century shuttle route with no founding date.

facts.statement: Asteroid-belt mining supplies the shipyards.
facts.howUsed: Not found. Canon mentions the belt for pilot training.

facts.statement: Dilithium is mined on Io from 2049.
facts.howUsed: From a reference book.

facts.statement: A base is established on Pluto in 2039.
facts.howUsed: From a reference book.

facts.statement: Relay networks serve the Sol system before subspace.
facts.howUsed: Canon dates no relay network in the Sol system before subspace, only exploration: Pioneer 11 at Saturn in 1979 and the crewed Europa Mission in 2024. The pre-subspace constellations in the dataset are inferred.
